newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil's Santos port.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at Brazil's Santos port.

text.p: Santos port reported the following conditions for shipments of soybeans and soymeal:

Vessels: Mentese loading 47,000 tonnes soybeans. Ziemia Krakowska still waiting to dock, awaiting cargo. Hilon of Sparta expected by March 21, to load 55,000 soybeans. Sanko Ranger expected 28/03, to load 11,500 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Ossolineum leaving at 11.00 a.m. local (1400 GMT). Merinee currently undergoing repairs at port, expected to load 32,000 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 382 trucks arrived Wednesday unloading 10,127 tonnes soybeans.

NOTE: The port authority Codesp said a total of 70,445 tonnes of soybeans and 13,029 tonnes of soymeal have been loaded for the month up to March 19. At the Cargill terminal, 53,857 tonnes soybeans were loaded in March so far. No soymeal was loaded. Figures for the private Cutrale terminal were not available.
